verdict.rationale: The only programmatic channel in evidence is EFILE, where certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers transmit returns system-to-system and track transmission history. That channel is gated behind CRA software certification and filer enrollment and covers only return filing. Every other service (business registration, payments, enquiries, documents) is described only as online web forms and portals, not a public API. Missing for 10: an openly documented public API with published specs, self-serve developer access, programmatic coverage beyond tax-return transmission, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
